items.title: Facts live in shared modules with confirmation dates; nothing on a page restates a fact as a literal
A forbidden-claims test covers every rejected claim and scans all served text
The prerendered or SSR body equals the visible content; markup equals what is shown
Language per URL, hreflang only for translated paths, and /id links never point at untranslated /id paths
robots.txt: wildcard group, named group of documented crawler tokens, admin and API disallowed, Sitemap line, no non-standard directives (Lighthouse rejects Content-Signal there)
sitemap.xml lists every indexable URL (dynamic ones included), with lastmod from the page-dates record and xhtml hreflang pairs
Status codes: real 404 with noindex; retired URLs 301 to the live page answering the same question; trailing slash 301; one host (www or apex); http to https
A canonical on every indexable page, equal to og:url; none on noindex pages
Titles 50 to 60 characters, naming the place, unique; descriptions 120 to 158, unique
<html lang> per URL; og:locale plus alternate

Structured data valid: WebSite, Organization (with industry subtype), place as LocalBusiness plus specific subtypes with address, geo, hasMap (share link and ?cid= URL), openingHoursSpecification (midnight is 23:59), priceRange, amenityFeature, sameAs; BreadcrumbList on every page
Open Graph and Twitter complete; og:image is a 1200x630 PNG, never SVG
Every meaningful image has alt text; the hero is preloaded at the right size; LCP is within budget on mobile
Local Lighthouse: SEO and accessibility at 100 (WARN 90 to 99, FAIL below 90)
The public bundle excludes admin and staff consoles; JS size is tracked between audits
Favicons and manifest are unhashed and injected server-side; manifest is served as application/manifest+json (display: "browser" when a separate installable app exists)
Admin and private routes carry noindex; hashed assets carry X-Robots-Tag: noindex
Internal links: every indexable page is within 2 clicks of home; the footer links contact, privacy and terms in the reader's language
IndexNow key file served; all indexable URLs submitted on production boot
Search Console, Bing Webmaster and Yandex Webmaster verified, with the sitemap submitted
Google Business Profile: specific category, hours and NAP identical to the site, description consistent with the positioning, real photos, reviews answered
Trust pages: contact page (ContactPage markup), a privacy policy that matches what the code collects, and terms
An intent map exists: clusters, prompts per language, required answer, URL, status, gap cause
Intent coverage: share of clusters rated strong (report the number; WARN below 70%, FAIL below 50%)
A URL per high-value intent (for example: guide, rates, contact, programme)
An FAQ on every content page: the question as it is typed into an assistant, the answer in the first sentence, then the next detail; both languages
FAQPage markup equals the rendered FAQ exactly
A key-facts TL;DR near the top of money, about and programme pages: numbers first, sources beside third-party claims
HowTo on guides, Course with CourseInstance on programmes, OfferCatalog on prices
Answer-first leads; headings phrased as the question or the topic
Tables and grids also have a sentence equivalent (merged cells flatten badly)
Owner-confirmed superlatives answered plainly ("Ya." followed by the facts); unconfirmed ones are never claimed

Editorial pages show a byline, a reviewer (only if the owner approves) and a visible <time>; JSON-LD carries author, publisher, datePublished (from git), dateModified, reviewedBy and lastReviewed from one dates record
Question queries from Search Console (who, what, where, how much, berapa, di mana, bagaimana) each map to an FAQ entry or a page
AI crawlers allowed: named groups present, and no WAF, CDN or bot-protection rule blocking the documented tokens (test with each token's user agent)
/llms.txt and /.well-known/llms.txt and /llms-full.txt, generated from the fact modules, linked from every page head
/.well-known/ai.txt (with Content-Signal), /ai/summary.json, /ai/faq.json, /feed.xml
Entity consistency: the same name, NAP, hours and category across the site, JSON-LD, llms files, Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Wikidata and OSM
sameAs complete (socials, booking, community, maps cid); topic linked through sport or knowsAbout to Wikidata and Wikipedia; alternateName lists the names people use
Statistic density on money pages (report the number; WARN below 5 per 100 words, which is the JAL threshold set from Padel Party's measured 9 to 18)
Inline citations beside third-party claims, not only a press list at the bottom
At least one verified verbatim quote from independent coverage on about and programme pages (N/A when there is no coverage)
Rendered-text hygiene: no joined words in split headings or flex siblings, no marquee noise, no mid-animation numbers for bots, no copy contradicting facts
Crawler log live, with an admin view per bot, page and day
Crawl coverage: key URLs read by bingbot, OAI-SearchBot or ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot within the last 14 days
Press records fetched, read and live; dead links removed
Offsite list-intent presence: for each list-intent cluster, the brand appears on the top third-party pages that answer it
Programmatic pages from real data where the business produces data (for example a monthly leaderboard archive)
